explanation: Salary and work-expense budget are separate annual dollar amounts; read k, grand, ordinary typos and attached units in context. Do not silently convert a stated currency.

Salary/budget anchors are not proposal limits; permitted non-negative values extrapolate. Vacation is annual, default usual 30; remote working is weekly across five workdays, default usual three. Annual vacation cannot exceed 365 and remote work cannot exceed five workdays. Do not invent a monthly conversion.
Add clearly requested extra vacation to the usual 30; respect explicit periods. Ask for volunteering in days rather than assuming an afternoon is half a day.

Ignore the supplied year; use month/day internally in 2026. Month alone/early means day 1; mid means day 15; end means the last day. ASAP means January 1. Ask about conflicting dates unless one clearly replaces the other. A start after September triggers the fixed failure rule; other benefits cannot make that agreement feasible.
A minimum, range or possible cap is not one guaranteed payment. Do not choose a bound without the agreed convention. Keep alternatives separate rather than combining their benefits.

Bare company car means dedicated car; membership means company-paid sponsorship; receiving a mentor means mentoring participation; a training plan counts as training participation. Health insurance without a contribution does not establish the employer premium share; explicit free insurance means 100%.

Ordinary job benefits describe the candidate’s package, even in recruiter-proposed wording. For explicit duties, I/we means the proposer and you the counterpart. Do not reverse who attends, coaches, organises or pays.

An explicit later salary/budget total after probation replaces its initial total; retain probation separately. Do not also award a duplicate pay-rise benefit. A review, promotion, conditional bonus and guaranteed pay increase are distinct promises.
Carry forward earlier choices only when the current text actually refers to them, and only to the extent of that reference. A new salary alone does not inherit an old budget/date.

Recognise the issue, not every incidental qualification. Mentor duration and bank-holiday inclusion need not be restated as separate features. Tentative but meaningful training or sponsorship must be acknowledged. An unfinished heading or general background may be ignored.
Ordinary willingness to help with company posts can mean the usual commitment; a concrete post count alone does not establish a fraction of the usual workload.

Use a genuinely matching issue or acknowledge the idea without points; do not force a nearby but different benefit. Permanent contracts, unusual timing and staged versions of existing issues do not automatically create new issue categories.

Protected time for learning is not automatically company-funded participation in an external training program. A standalone Participation with no named activity does not establish which activity is accepted. Ask what that word refers to.
Career advancement or Recruitment fair position as an unfinished heading does not select a review arrangement or commitment. Do not select a benefit just because its topic is named.

Copy a short continuous piece of the actual current offer for each pair. Do not correct its spelling or punctuation inside the quote; put the normalized choice in option. Prior offer text is context only unless the current offer explicitly refers to it.
